items.markdown:
![Massaman Curry Origins: The Historic Taste of Thailand](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/07280251-1672-0139-0000-d1f83a639073:8)
Massaman curry originated in `17th-century Thailand` at the cosmopolitan royal court of Ayutthaya. It is a fusion dish born from international trade, combining the cooking techniques and spices of Persian and Indian merchants with native Thai ingredients like lemongrass, galangal, and shrimp paste.[](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Massaman_curry) [[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Massaman_curry)[[2]](https://nakaravillasandglamping.com/our-speciality-massaman-curry/)[[3]](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/travel/article/deconstructing-massaman-curry-thailand-mellow-classic)

The word "Massaman" is a phonetic derivation of *Mussulman* , an archaic Persian and English term for "Muslim". Because of its Islamic roots, the dish traditionally features halal meats like beef, chicken, or mutton, and is particularly popular in southern Thailand.[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_4R1ezmO9Yc&t=3) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_4R1ezmO9Yc&t=3)[[2]](https://www.exoticfoodthailand.com/create-our-delicious-thai-massaman-curry/)[[3]](https://www.facebook.com/MichelinGuideAsia/posts/massaman-curry-takes-center-stage-as-the-true-hero-of-this-culinary-journey-from/1369288865238112/)[[4]](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/massaman-curry/)[[5]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=THcfqRk4NyI&t=461)

The defining characteristics and historical influences of the curry include:

- **The Spices:** Unlike traditional Thai curries (which rely on fresh herbs), Massaman uses a heavy dose of dried, imported spices like cardamom, cinnamon, cloves, star anise, and cumin.[](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Massaman_curry) 
- **The Fusion:** The Indian and Persian spice profiles are softened with classic Southeast Asian coconut milk and balanced with salty fish sauce, sour tamarind, and sweet palm sugar.[](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/travel/article/deconstructing-massaman-curry-thailand-mellow-classic) [[1]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DWZexNujeJV/)
- **The Ingredients:** The curry typically includes potatoes and peanuts—ingredients not traditionally found in native Thai cooking, likely introduced via European trade networks.[](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Massaman_curry)
